purpose: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next for agentic coding: four native 262,144-token slots (1,048,576 total), NVFP4 experts, PLE table read in place from NVMe, MTP k=3, fp8 KV, prefix cache, decode CUDA graphs. Optional engine (switch alias qwen38fn); qwen38-1m stays the default. Text only.

status.decision: measured 2026-10-11 (candidate 5, scripts/94_qualify_profile.py plus the preregistered gate_verdict.py): gate PASS. 0 kill lines and 0.00 GiB swap growth in both starts, external low point 12.25 GiB, vLLM KV 1,079,117 tokens at 262,144, direct 1M fill 1,000,672 tokens, restart identity 3/3, tools 20/20, agent gate 4/4, soak 212 requests 0 errors. Decode 25.80 tok/s @0 and 35.54 @28K, prefill 2,684 tok/s @28K beat qwen38-1m; short-prompt TTFT 0.569 s misses the 0.5 s target (qwen38-1m 0.39 s). Holdout (results/qwen38fn-gates/holdout-2026-10-11/): GSM8K 98/100, MMLU-Pro 218/247, HumanEval 138/164 = 454/511 vs qwen38-1m 438/511. Fidelity NO_RESULT: no BF16 teacher; NVFP4 weights and fp8 KV as NVIDIA publishes them. Text only: images at 1M are NO_GO (results/qwen38fn-gates/diag-vision-2026-10-11/). Optional engine; owner's choice 2026-10-11, qwen38-1m stays default.

safety.note: 10 GiB whole-host floor per the AGENTS.md 1M gate. minimum_start_gib is the switch's only admission: candidate 5 used up to 102.97 GiB from preload to the 1M-fill low (115.22 -> 12.25 GiB), so a start needs 113 GiB to keep the floor (the 93_profile_serve budget is 112.2). cgroup MemoryCurrent is blind to CUDA unified memory on GB10; the external memwatch is the real guard. The PLE table's page cache is clean and file-backed (reclaimable).

memory_model.basis: Sized from the 2026-10-11 diagnostic smoke (results/qwen38fn-gates/smoke-2026-10-11). Every logged KV usage reading is a whole number of blocks over 91, so its 4,200,000,000-byte arena held 92 blocks (<= 45,652,174 bytes each), and 194,493 tokens at --max-model-len 131,072 means a request reserves 62 blocks: one group grows by cdiv(L, 3200) (41) and 21 are GDN state (4 groups x 5) plus the QSA ring (1). A 262,144-token slot reserves 103 blocks; four need 412, plus the BlockPool null block and 2 x 4 transient prefill blocks (the smoke held 36 blocks for a 32-block reservation): 421 blocks <= 19,219,565,254 bytes. The fixed 19.22 GB arena (--kv-cache-memory-bytes, 17.90 GiB) is extra_gib. resident_weights_gib + overhead_gib = 84.2 GiB is the measured non-KV footprint (MemAvailable 112.38 -> 25.73 GiB plus 1.44 GiB pushed to swap, less the 3.91 GiB arena; vLLM reported 75.67 GiB of weights). Projected idle on a quiet 114 GiB host: ~11.9 GiB, above the 10 GiB floor with little room; the direct 1M fill needs a quiet host. vLLM's startup log must show >= 1,048,576 tokens at 262,144. Measured 2026-10-11 (results/qwen38fn-gates/diag-drafter-2026-10-11, arm C: drafter FP8 MoE off DeepGEMM, checkpoint page cache evicted during startup): vLLM reported 1,079,117 tokens at 262,144; idle 13.9 GiB from a 115.2 GiB quiet start (101.3 GiB used vs 102.2 GiB modeled); 0 NVRM lines.

qualification_targets.note: qwen38-1m README row (results/qwen38-gates/speed-2026-08-18, accuracy-2026-08-18); Flash-Next must match or beat these to replace or complement the default. Speed targets are general, misses are reported.
